description: This file is a core source implementation of the prplMesh Controller component, handling initialization, message processing, and management of network nodes, agents, and communication with the broker and other subsystems. It includes setup for periodic tasks, command message handling, and network management functions.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Main class implementing the network controller, managing nodes, communication, and periodic tasks.

classes.name: Agent
classes.description: Represents an agent device with its associated radios, network state, and capabilities.

classes.name: channel_selection_task
classes.description: Handles channel selection and dynamic channel management processes within the network.

classes.name: load_balancer_task
classes.description: Responsible for load balancing operations on the network's radios.

classes.name: optimal_path_task
classes.description: Manages optimal routing paths for clients based on network conditions.

classes.name: vbss_task
classes.description: Handles Virtual BSS (VBSS) creation, destruction, and movement procedures.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the controller, loads persistent data, sets up timers, and starts communication processes.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down timers, communication handlers, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: bool handle_cmdu(int fd,uint32_t iface_index,const sMacAddr & dst_mac,const sMacAddr & src_mac,ieee1905_1::CmduMessageRx & cmdu_rx)
methods.description: Processes received IEEE 1905.1 CMDUs based on message type, delegating to specific handling functions.

methods.name: send_cmdu
methods.description: Sends a CMDU via the controller's CMDU server.

methods.name: send_cmdu_to_broker
methods.description: Transmits a CMDU to the broker server with specified destination and source MAC addresses.

methods.name: start_client_steering
methods.description: Initiates client steering procedure towards a specified target BSSID.

methods.name: reconfig_apmld
methods.description: Reconfigures an Agent's MLD with specified add or remove link options.

methods.name: reconfig_bstamld
methods.description: Reconfigures a Backhaul STA MLD with specified add or remove link options.

methods.name: send_btm_request
methods.description: Sends a BSS Transition Management request to steer a client to a specific BSSID.

methods.name: trigger_scan
methods.description: Triggers a channel scan on the specified radio over given channels.

methods.name: trigger_set_spatial_reuse
methods.description: Sends a spatial reuse request to all connected agents with specified parameters.

methods.name: trigger_vbss_creation
methods.description: Initiates creation of a Virtual BSS (VBSS) with given parameters.

methods.name: trigger_vbss_destruction
methods.description: Destroys a specified VBSS and optionally disassociates the client.

methods.name: update_agent_vbss_capabilities
methods.description: Requests an update of VBSS capabilities for a specified agent.

methods.name: trigger_vbss_move
methods.description: Handles moving a client VBSS to a different RUID (Radio UID).

methods.name: set_eht_operations
methods.description: Configures EHT (Extremely High Throughput) operations on a radio BSS.
